so_reg_summary: A post-market monitoring system is established and documented in a manner that is proportionate to the nature of the AI technologies and the risks of the high-risk AI system, actively and systematically collecting, documenting and analysing relevant data to evaluate continued compliance; market-surveillance cooperation under Regulation (EU) 2019/1020 applies (Art. 72(1)–(2) + Art. 74(1)).
req_title: Provider of high-risk AI system establishes and documents a post-market monitoring system proportionate to the nature of the AI technologies and the risks, actively and systematically collecting, documenting and analysing relevant data across the AI lifecycle
sr_title: Post-market monitoring feedback loop with documented analysis
articles: Art. 72(1)–(2) — `Providers shall establish and document a post-market monitoring system in a manner that is proportionate to the nature of the AI technologies and the risks of the high-risk AI system. The post-market monitoring system shall actively and systematically collect, document and analyse relevant data`; Art. 74(1) — `Regulation (EU) 2019/1020 shall apply to AI systems covered by this Regulation`

req_title: High-risk AI system technically allows automatic recording of events (logs) over the lifetime of the system with traceability appropriate to the intended purpose; provider keeps logs under their control for at least six months
sr_title: Lifetime automatic logging of high-risk AI system events
articles: Art. 12(1) — `High-risk AI systems shall technically allow for the automatic recording of events (logs) over the lifetime of the system`; Art. 12(2) — `In order to ensure a level of traceability of the functioning of a high-risk AI system that is appropriate to the intended purpose of the system, logging capabilities shall enable the recording of events relevant for: (a) … (b) … (c) …`

req_title: Provider ensures high-risk AI system is tested for the purpose of identifying risk management measures, performs consistently for intended purpose, may be tested in real-world conditions per Article 60, and achieves appropriate accuracy/robustness/cybersecurity throughout the AI-system lifecycle
sr_title: Risk-measure validation through targeted testing
articles: Art. 9(6) — `High-risk AI systems shall be tested for the purpose of identifying the most appropriate and targeted risk management measures. Testing shall ensure that high-risk AI systems perform consistently for their intended purpose`; Art. 9(7) — `Testing procedures may include testing in real-world conditions in accordance with Article 60`
